COUNT(h.quantity) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(h.fiscal_year) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT h.fiscal_year) = 1 THEN SUM(h.quantity) END AS quantity FROM (SELECT stat_month, belong_base, material_code, MIN(fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(dimension_act_dl_qty) END AS quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(national_dimension_fiscal_act_dl_qty) END AS annual_quantity FROM (SELECT DISTINCT stat_month, belong_base, TRIM(dimension_value) AS material_code, fiscal_year, dimension_act_dl_qty, national_dimension_fiscal_act_dl_qty FROM agents_scm_base_dimension_delivery_mi WHERE dimension_type = '基地+产品') AS raw_values GROUP BY stat_month, belong_base, material_code) AS h INNER JOIN (SELECT TRIM(material_code) AS material_code, MIN(TRIM(sub_category)) AS category FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi WHERE material_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(material_code) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(material_code) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(sub_category)) = 1 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN sub_category IS NULL OR TRIM(sub_category) = '' THEN 1 END) = 0) AS p ON h.material_code = p.material_code GROUP BY h.stat_month, p.category) AS b ON b.category = m.category AND b.stat_month = CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(m.stat_month, 5, 2) = '01' THEN CONCAT(CAST(CAST(SUBSTRING(m.stat_month, 1, 4) AS INT) - 1 AS STRING), '12') ELSE CAST(CAST(m.stat_month AS INT) - 1 AS STRING) END LEFT JOIN (SELECT h.fiscal_year, p.category, CASE WHEN COUNT(h.annual_quantity) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(h.annual_quantity) END AS annual_quantity FROM (SELECT fiscal_year, material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(annual_quantity) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT annual_quantity) = 1 THEN MAX(annual_quantity) END AS annual_quantity FROM (SELECT stat_month, belong_base, material_code, MIN(fiscal_year) AS fiscal_year, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(dimension_act_dl_qty) END AS quantity, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(national_dimension_fiscal_act_dl_qty) END AS annual_quantity FROM (SELECT DISTINCT stat_month, belong_base, TRIM(dimension_value) AS material_code, fiscal_year, dimension_act_dl_qty, national_dimension_fiscal_act_dl_qty FROM agents_scm_base_dimension_delivery_mi WHERE dimension_type = '基地+产品') AS raw_values GROUP BY stat_month, belong_base, material_code) AS sku_values GROUP BY fiscal_year, material_code) AS h INNER JOIN (SELECT TRIM(material_code) AS material_code, MIN(TRIM(sub_category)) AS category FROM agents_dim_product_list_mi WHERE material_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(material_code) <> '' GROUP BY TRIM(material_code) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(sub_category)) = 1 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN sub_category IS NULL OR TRIM(sub_category) = '' THEN 1 END) = 0) AS p ON h.material_code = p.material_code GROUP BY h.fiscal_year, p.category) AS f ON f.category = m.category AND f.fiscal_year = m.fiscal_year WHERE m.stat_month IN (:gea_p1) ORDER BY m.stat_month, m.category LIMIT :gea_p98 OFFSET :gea_p99
